viewing_check: Estimate 30-60, current bid $25 (+22% premium). Value is mostly the pastel wool blanket ($35-66 sold, 2024-2026, steady) and maybe 3-4 flour sacks ($25-31 each for named 50lb bags, others $8-20). Check blanket size, moth holes, stains, and which flour mills are printed on the sacks (named Tasmanian or Australian mills sell better). Bulky to post.
